{{Quote|It is only I, Governor, a humble servant of the Emperor, Captain-Supervisor Grammel. I am in charge of the secret mining colony on Circarpous V.|Grammel, to Governor Essada|<ref name="SotME" />}}
The '''Imperial Department of Resources''',<ref name="SotME" /> also known as '''Imperial Mining''',<ref name="M-M">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/splinter|text=Mini-Mimban|int=Mini-Mimban}}</ref> was a bureau within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It supervised the development and/or exploitation of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], usually for the purposes of mineral extraction and colonization.<ref name="AGttSWU" /> A represtative of the Imperial Department of Resources, [[Captain-Supervisor]] [[Grammel]] was [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]]<ref name="SotME" /> and [[Energy mining/Legends|energy mining]] operation<ref name="Grammel DB">{{DB|character|captainsupervisorgrammel|Grammel, Captain-Supervisor}}</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]]<ref name="SotME" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Department of Resources was originally created for ''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]'', a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Alan Dean Foster]]<ref name="SotME" /> and released on [[February 12]], [[1978]].<ref name="SotME release date">{{Twitter|DelReyStarWars|status/963065768794607616|[[Del Rey|Star Wars Books]]|quote=On this day, 40 years ago, Del Rey Books published Splinter of the Mind's Eye, written by Alan Dean Foster.|archivefile=File:SotME release date.png}}</ref>
